CatholicVote pressed Massachusetts bishops to excommunicate Gov. Maura Healey after she signed a law eliminating restrictions on abortions after 24 weeks.

The Poison:
Using the threat of excommunication as a political cudgel weaponizes sacred traditions to score partisan points rather than heal souls.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a Plane Error (WHAT vs WHO): framing a legislative policy debate as a test of personal spiritual purity to force compliance.

Social Physics Analysis:
Rather than fostering open dialogue or compassionate understanding, both sides project corrupt motives onto opponents, using moral mandates to secure power.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
The gap between moral pretexts and political polarization plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Laws governing life and abortion touch deeply held, irreconcilable moral convictions.

The Unavoidable Lie: Excommunication is a neutral administrative tool.
